acceptanceCriteria: manifest.json is valid MV3 with action, content_scripts, background service_worker, storage permission
Double-click on an English word triggers a tooltip with the Chinese translation or a "no translation" marker
Seed dictionary (~20 words) is loaded into chrome.storage.local on install
background service worker responds to GET_TRANSLATION and suppresses the tooltip when suppress=true
popup.html renders the full dictionary list sorted alphabetically
User can add a new EN->ZH pair; invalid input is rejected with a visible message
User can edit an existing translation and the change persists across reloads
User can delete an entry or mark it as "no translation" (suppress=true)
README.md explains the no-network design and Load Unpacked install flow
Extension loads in Chrome via chrome://extensions Load Unpacked without errors
Icons present at 16/48/128 px referenced by manifest.json
